UserProfile.title: Warden Profile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated GlimmerFall player account profile registered via Firebase Google Sign-In.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified account email address (PII, restricted to owner and admin).

playerId.description: Linked cross-platform GlimmerFall Warden sync identifier.

role.description: Fixed player role; elevated admin access is stored separately in /admins.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

DailyQuestProgress.title: Daily Quest Progress
DailyQuestProgress.description: UTC daily quest progress and claimed reward tracking per registered Warden.

tapsCompleted.description: Count of Glimmer Nodes channeled today.

upgradesCompleted.description: Count of Entity or Artisan upgrades completed today.

duelsCompleted.description: Count of Nexus PvP duels completed today.

blocksAnchored.description: Count of GlimmerChain state blocks anchored today.

claimedQuestIds.description: Allowlisted quest IDs claimed today (max 6 entries).

status.description: Daily quest completion state; locks to terminal all_claimed when every quest is claimed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when today's quest log was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest quest progress or claim.

/users/{userId}.description: Private authenticated user profile documents isolated by owner UID.

/users/{userId}/dailyQuests/{questDate}.description: Daily quest progress and reward claim documents scoped to each authenticated user.
